$description: +Prayer design tokens (W3C Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10). Tier A only (design-direction.md §0): signature components plus color and type roles. Native chrome (menus, sheets, alerts, search field, nav/tool bars, switches, pickers) takes platform metrics and has no tokens here. Dimensions are in px = iOS points = Android dp. Source values: app/lib/theme/tokens.dart and design-direction.md. This file is the source of truth; Swift and Kotlin are generated from it.

color.$description: Every color has one job (design-direction §1): blue = do this, gold = held, everything else neutral. No red, no pink. color.dark and color.light hold the same roles (heldGlow and unsealedRim are dark-only).

sheet.$description: Custom (Tier A) overlays only, e.g. the Amen invitation if it isn't a native sheet: a slight lift from the ground (1.08:1). Native sheets use the platform material.

cardSurface.$description: The community card and other in-content containers (1.13:1 step).

raised.$description: Fields, pills, settings groups on a sheet.

historyNode.$description: A History strand node: a full neutral disc (history.md), never an avatar color.

thread.$description: The intention thread. Neutral always; never changes color or weight.

inkMuted.$description: Secondary text. 7.1:1 on ground, ≥5.6:1 on every surface.

carriedMark.$description: The carried mark. Below 3:1 on purpose (design-direction §5).

switchTrackOn.$description: A switch's "on" track: inkMuted, no brighter, with the standard white knob (design-direction §1, app-wide).

switchTrackOff.$description: A switch's "off" track: ink at ~14%, a faint groove, so on and off differ by fill. Android only: iOS keeps the native switch, whose off track is the system's (design-direction §1).

primary.$description: Blue = do this: pray button, Amen, the invitation's tap target, primary buttons. Never status or decoration.

heldGold.$description: Gold = held: rings, intention dots, card border, halo. Non-text (≥3:1).

heldGlow.$description: Dark only (light has none): the prayer halo and the brief check bloom. Never a static glow.

onHeld.$description: The check glyph on a gold check.

scrim.$description: Behind custom (Tier A) overlays only; native sheets bring their own dimming.

onboardingGlow.$description: Onboarding's Candlelight: one soft warm glow behind the content on Home's own ground, breathing slowly; the same in both appearances (onboarding is dark in both; auth-onboarding.md, Flow (redesigned 2026-11-09, second pass)). Text uses Home's ink / inkMuted.

onboardingPaper.$description: The moment's paper line (onboarding step 2): the stand-in for a photographed line of the real list paper, the same in both appearances.

onboardingPaperInk.$description: The name set on the paper line (11.6:1 on onboardingPaper); its perforations and guide line at number.onboarding.paperPerforation / paperGuide.

onboardingPaperMuted.$description: The paper line's "List 53" label (4.7:1 on onboardingPaper).

unsealed.$description: The unsealed seal: the same shape, unpressed, neutral (before the list is published).

unsealedRim.$description: Dark only: the unsealed blank's rim light (at wax.darkRimOpacity).

raised.$description: Fields, pills, settings groups on a sheet.

historyNode.$description: A History strand node: a full neutral disc (history.md), never an avatar color.

thread.$description: The intention thread. Neutral always; never changes color or weight.

carriedMark.$description: The carried mark. Below 3:1 on purpose (design-direction §5).

switchTrackOn.$description: A switch's "on" track: inkMuted, no brighter, with the standard white knob (design-direction §1, app-wide).

switchTrackOff.$description: A switch's "off" track: ink at ~14%, a faint groove, so on and off differ by fill. Android only: iOS keeps the native switch, whose off track is the system's (design-direction §1).

primary.$description: Blue = do this: pray button, Amen, the invitation's tap target, primary buttons. Never status or decoration.

heldGold.$description: Gold = held: rings, intention dots, card border, halo. Non-text (≥3:1).

onHeld.$description: The check glyph on a gold check (4.0:1, a glyph).

scrim.$description: Behind custom (Tier A) overlays only; native sheets bring their own dimming.

onboardingGlow.$description: = dark (onboarding is dark in both appearances).

onboardingPaper.$description: = dark (onboarding is dark in both appearances).

onboardingPaperInk.$description: = dark (onboarding is dark in both appearances).

onboardingPaperMuted.$description: = dark (onboarding is dark in both appearances).

unsealed.$description: The unsealed seal: the same shape, unpressed, neutral (before the list is published).

onAvatar.$description: Initials on an avatar tone: white at 70% (0xB3), so the letters lightly take on the tone (design-direction §1b). Vermilion and olive fall to 2.6–2.9:1 at this opacity.

avatarTone.$description: Monogram tones by PrayerSubject.avatarTone (0–15; default = FNV-1a(subject id) mod 16). Same palette in both themes; dark blends each tone avatarDarkDim toward black. FROZEN AT LAUNCH: changing an index recolors everyone's people.

wax.$description: Wax by PrayerList.sealVariant (0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday), the ritual's 7-day rotation. base = the wax body; sheen = its highlight (the stamp's relief maps face → base, highlights → sheen).

avatarDarkDim.$description: Dark theme: each avatar tone blended this far toward black.

waxDarkLift.$description: Dark theme only: how far each wax body lifts toward its sheen so it separates from dark surfaces. Sunday's gold and Friday's brass already separate.

waxDarkRimOpacity.$description: Dark theme only: the seal's rim light (its sheen; the unsealed blank uses color.dark.unsealedRim) at this opacity.

pressed.$description: Ink over an in-content container (the search match hint) while pressed.

initialsScale.$description: Avatar initials: body sans at this share of the disc's diameter.

clusterSeparator.$description: Overlapping cluster avatars: a ring in the surface's color, this share of the avatar's diameter.

initialsTracking.$description: Two-letter initials tracked apart by this share of their size.

restLow.$description: The glow's breath, low opacity at rest (the edge line holds steady).

restHigh.$description: The glow's breath, high opacity at rest.

reduceMotion.$description: Reduce Motion: the glow is static at this opacity (mid-breath), no breath, no flare.

flarePeak.$description: The committing Amen's flare peak opacity (0.99 is fine).

flareReach.$description: The flare's reach, × the resting reach.

lightWidthScale.$description: Light theme widens the glow so it doesn't vanish on the pale ground.

bloomRiseShare.$description: The check bloom: share of its duration spent swelling (ease-out); the rest settles (ease-in).

checkGlyph.$description: The check glyph inside a held check, as a share of its diameter.

checkDash.$description: The partial check's dash, as a share of its diameter.

checkSpringFrom.$description: The held check springs in from this scale (Reduce Motion: no scale, a fade).

prayButtonDim.$description: During the countdown the pray button's disc is the action blue at this opacity (over raised); solid once Amen is available.

historyBloom.$description: The bloom pressed into a History node on a list day: ink at this opacity, like initials on an avatar (history.md).

contextRow.$description: A name shown only as the parent of an intention the filter keeps (design-direction §4: a held name with an unheld intention under Still to hold) is dimmed to this opacity; the intention stays full strength. Flutter's tuned value.

countdownPie.$description: The countdown before Amen: a small pie inside the button, this share of its diameter, running down to nothing (no ring outside, no change in size).

glowWidth.$description: The Candlelight glow: an ellipse this fraction of the screen's width as its horizontal radius.

glowHeight.$description: The glow's vertical radius, as a fraction of the screen's height.

glowCenterY.$description: The glow's center, from the top, as a fraction of the screen's height.

glowMid.$description: The glow's opacity at glowMidStop, relative to its center (0.05 of 0.16).

glowMidStop.$description: Where the glow reaches glowMid, as a fraction of its radius.

glowEndStop.$description: Where the glow is gone, as a fraction of its radius.

glowRestLow.$description: The glow's breath: low opacity (high is 1).

glowReduceMotion.$description: Reduce Motion: the glow is static at this opacity.

formScale.$description: An avatar forming starts at this scale (then 1).

disabledTint.$description: The blue button while it can't be used: primary at this opacity.

hairline.$description: A field's rule: ink at this opacity.

hairlineFocused.$description: A focused field's rule: ink at this opacity.

paperPerforation.$description: The paper line's stitch lines: onboardingPaperInk at this opacity.

paperGuide.$description: The paper line's guide line: onboardingPaperInk at this opacity.

paperShadow.$description: The paper line's shadow: shadow at this opacity.

paperNameScale.$description: The name shrinks onto the paper line: 28 → 22.

paperTracking.$description: The paper's "LIST 53" label tracking, in em.

leadTop.$description: Steps 1 and 2: the space above the content, as a fraction of the screen's height (132 pt on an 874 pt screen; never less than space.xl).

display.$description: Display serif: names on Home, list numbers, big lines only (design-direction §2). Bundled; see the assets plan.

body.$description: The platform system font: SF Pro on iOS, Roboto on Android. Never bundled.

typography.$description: Type roles. Display roles are Roca; text roles are the system sans. Every role scales with Dynamic Type / font scale: the ios.textStyle extension names the iOS text style a role maps to (system roles use it directly; Roca roles scale relative to it). android.style is the Material 3 role for the Kotlin port.

displayTitle.$description: A name as a page title (You, detail pages).

displayLine.$description: Big lines: the invitation, "You'll be carried on List 53".

intention.$description: Intentions on Home: smaller sans, regular, ~7:1.

body.$description: Body text; the search empty-state line.

bodySmall.$description: Card counts and status lines, secondary body.

count.$description: Timer and counts: tabular figures. When a count rises live, crossfade only the changed digits.

onboardingLead.$description: Onboarding's one big line per step ("Here, we pray for each other."): Roca regular, never bold (auth-onboarding.md, Type).

onboardingLeadSmall.$description: Onboarding's lead on the person steps ("Who do you pray for?", "What are you praying for, for Mom?"): Roca regular.

onboardingName.$description: The user's name in the moment (step 2), in Roca bold as it prints; on the paper line it scales to number.onboarding.paperNameScale (22).

onboardingPersonName.$description: The person's name under their avatar on the intention step ("Mom").

onboardingMechanic.$description: The moment's one true sentence ("Pray with today's list. Tomorrow your name is on it.").

onboardingField.$description: Onboarding's centered fields (your name, the intention): sans over a hairline, no box.

onboardingFieldLabeled.$description: Onboarding's labeled fields (the person's name, what you call them): sans, leading, over a hairline.

onboardingFieldLabel.$description: A field's label above it on the person step ("Name", "What you call them"), inkMuted; "· optional" in bodySmall inkFaint.

onboardingPaperLabel.$description: The paper line's "LIST 53" label: uppercase, tracked number.onboarding.paperTracking em, onboardingPaperMuted.

sectionTitle.$description: Section titles on a page ("Intentions", "History"): system sans, Title 3 semibold (detail-page.md, 2026-11-08; Roca is for proper names).

intentionTitle.$description: An intention as a page title: system sans, Title 2 semibold; wraps (detail-page.md, 2026-11-08).

periodLabel.$description: A History period's label ("November"): system sans, Headline (detail-page.md).

initials.$description: Avatar initials: body sans, not the serif. Size = number.initialsScale × the disc (17.6 at 44); tracking number.initialsTracking on two letters; optically centered. Does not scale with Dynamic Type (it tracks the disc).

space.$description: Spacing scale plus Home's named gaps (design-direction §3).

gutter.$description: Side margins on Home; text inset inside the community card.

groupGap.$description: The visible gap between one name group and the next (~24–28): the last row's ink to the next avatar. The list subtracts the rows' own insets.

cardToList.$description: Community card to the first row.

statusUnderAvatars.$description: The card's status line under its avatar row (~6–8).

radius.$description: In-content containers only. Floating controls are fully rounded capsules (platform glass); native chrome uses platform radii.

hint.$description: Small in-content containers (the search match hint): softer than a capsule, never reads as a field or pill.

row.$description: Name-row avatar. Also the add sheet's new-person avatar in its Name-tab toolbar (as tall as the round X) and the person header of its intention form for a known person (screens.md).

header.$description: Your avatar in Home's header: smaller so it doesn't compete.

large.$description: The profile at the top of You.

person.$description: A person at full size, how people recognize someone: the add sheet's Name tab and the subject's page (screens.md, detail-page.md).

picker.$description: The add sheet's For row and the rows of "Who is this for?" (screens.md).

initialsMinGlyph.$description: Below this, two initials drop to one; a disc too small for one is color only.

name.$description: Name row: the avatar plus its held ring's room. One line.

intention.$description: Intention row pitch; all of it is tap target.

ring.$description: Held ring stroke on 40–44 pt avatars and the community card. Crisp, solid, no glow. The ring scales in steps, not proportionally (design-direction §5, 2026-11-08): ringSmall / ring / ringLarge.

ringSmall.$description: Held ring stroke up to ~32 pt (a History strand node).

ringGapSmall.$description: Gap to the held ring up to ~32 pt.

ringLarge.$description: Held ring stroke at ~96 pt (a person's page, the add sheet's Name tab).

ringGapLarge.$description: Gap to the held ring at ~96 pt.

ringGap.$description: Gap between the avatar (or card) and its held ring.

dot.$description: The gold dot where the thread meets a held intention.

hitTarget.$description: The smallest tap target for a bare glyph button in the content (the ＋ on a page's Intentions title; HIG 44 pt).

node.$description: History strand (history.md, 2026-11-08): a node, a full neutral disc in color.historyNode. Its held ring is held.ringSmall / ringGapSmall outside it.

nodePitch.$description: A node's tap area (and its slot in the strand and the preview row): the disc plus the spacing around it.

bloom.$description: The carried-mark glyph pressed into a node on a list day, this tall, in ink at number.historyBloom.

journalDot.$description: A day with a journal entry: a neutral (inkMuted) dot on the node's upper trailing corner.

answeredMark.$description: A day an intention was answered: a small gold ✦ (heldGold) on the node's lower leading corner.

gap.$description: The slot of a folded run of empty days (`··`), whatever its length.

monthTab.$description: The month tab's minimum width: a tiny calendar page with the short month ("Nov").

monthTabBand.$description: The month tab's top band (the calendar page's binding), inkMuted.

listSeal.$description: The Lists tab: a list's wax seal at the start of its row.

chipMaxWidth.$description: History's filter chip: the alias or intention text truncates past this width.

radius.$description: The bend into each intention (≤ half the row or the branch's length).

check.$description: The prayer-mode check in a row's trailing slot.

name.$description: After a Roca name; scales with the text.

intention.$description: After a 13 pt intention; scales with the text.

carryRow.$description: Trailing the add sheet's "Carry onto the list" label at the label's size, inkMuted in every state (design-direction §5), centered on the label's cap height. Scales with the label.

stamp.$description: The day's seal, cropped into the card's top-left corner (~70% visible).

stampOffsetX.$description: How far the stamp sits left of the card's edge. Tune by outcome (bloom center + most petals visible).

stampOffsetY.$description: How far the stamp sits above the card's edge.

avatarOverlap.$description: ≤ ~4–5 so two-letter initials are never covered.

avatar.$description: Avatar clusters outside the card (Today's list, Your portion).

overlap.$description: How far each cluster avatar overlaps the one before it: as on the card (size.card.avatarOverlap), ≤ ~4–5 so two-letter initials are never covered.

invitation.$description: The day's seal at the top of the Amen invitation (Flutter's 1.3 × the default).

rimMinSize.$description: Seals smaller than this (beads) get the lift but no rim.

photoMinSize.$description: At and above this, seals use the photographed stamps (when D3 lands).

pitch.$description: A break (lists missed) is one pitch of bare space.

hollowStroke.$description: The current list's bead while unsealed: a hollow ring.

diameter.$description: Home's round pray button, the same height as the floating pill (size.bar.compact while the keyboard is up).

edge.$description: The solid gold line on the screen's edge, under the glow. Steady: only the glow breathes.

maxInwardReach.$description: At rest the visible glow stays within this distance of the screen edge.

bar.$description: Home's floating bar (design-direction §4; Tier A layout on the platform's glass, 2026-11-05).

height.$description: The pill's height: the same as the round pray button beside it.

icon.$description: History, Search and + in the pill.

inset.$description: The bar's gap from the screen's side edges.

gap.$description: Between the pill and the pray button.

compact.$description: The pill and the pray button while the keyboard is up (search): both shrink a little and ride above it.

header.$description: Home's header controls, each on its own glass (§4).

control.$description: The glass behind the streak badge and the filter: as tall as your header avatar.

icon.$description: The filter glyph and the chip's ×.

checkMark.$description: The prayer-mode check's strokes (size.check is its diameter).

partialStroke.$description: Partial: the gold ring and its dash.

minHeight.$description: The search match hint's minimum height (a comfortable tap target).

onboarding.$description: Onboarding (auth-onboarding.md, Flow redesigned 2026-11-09; the reference mock design/explorations/onboarding/d-merged).

button.$description: The one blue button's height (a capsule); it becomes the pray button in the hand-off.

buttonRest.$description: The button's gap above the bottom safe area while the keyboard is down (the mock's 680 pt slot on an 874 pt screen).

buttonAboveKeyboard.$description: The button's gap above the keyboard while it's up.

personAvatar.$description: The person's avatar on the person and intention steps.

hairline.$description: The rule under an onboarding field (ink at number.onboarding.hairline, hairlineFocused while focused).

fieldPadding.$description: Space above a field's text, between it and its hairline.

textRise.$description: Incoming text groups rise this far as they fade in.

textFall.$description: Outgoing text groups rise this far as they fade out.

paperRise.$description: The paper line rises this far as it fades in (the moment).

formBlur.$description: An avatar forming starts this blurred (then 0).

glowDrift.$description: The Candlelight glow drifts up this far at the top of its breath.

paper.$description: The moment's paper line (a stand-in for a photographed line of the real list).

perforationInset.$description: The dashed stitch lines' inset from the left and right edges.

perforationDash.$description: The stitch lines' dash length (and gap).

edgeInset.$description: The stitch lines' and the label's inset from the top and bottom edges.

labelInset.$description: The "LIST 53" label's inset from the trailing edge.

guideInset.$description: The guide line's inset from the leading and trailing edges.

guideTop.$description: The guide line's distance from the top edge (just under the name).

shadowRadius.$description: Its soft shadow's radius (the mock's 28 pt CSS blur).

duration.$description: Motion (design-direction §8). One signature moment (Amen → seal); the check's spring is the only spring; everything else is quiet and quick. Reduce Motion: springs and the bloom become fades at duration.quick; the halo is static.

quick.$description: Quick fades; Reduce Motion's replacement for springs and blooms.

spring.$description: The check's spring, the only spring in the app: this duration on easing.outBack (a small overshoot).

bloom.$description: The gold bloom on check, settling into the crisp ring.

linger.$description: Under Still to hold, held rows stay this long after Amen …

fold.$description: … then fold away over this (Reduce Motion: fade).

strip.$description: Praying on a detail page: what isn't the subject fades out together.

validationPause.$description: The add sheet's contact-info message shows this long after typing pauses (screens.md, add sheet).

haloBreath.$description: Half of the halo glow's breath (a full in-and-out cycle is 5 s).

haloFlare.$description: The committing Amen's flare, before the fade-out.

haloFlareRise.$description: The flare's fast rise (ease-out); the rest settles (ease-in-out).

haloFlareOffset.$description: From the Amen tap to the flare. Becomes the time to the seal's impact once the stamp animation exists.

prayHold.$description: The pray button's decaying ring before Amen appears; the invitation's ring.

onboardingTextOut.$description: Onboarding: outgoing text groups fade and rise (ease-in).

onboardingTextDelay.$description: Onboarding: incoming text groups start this long after a step change.

onboardingTravel.$description: Onboarding: an anchor (an avatar, the name) travels position and size together (ease-in-out).

onboardingButtonMorph.$description: The hand-off: the blue button becomes the pray button (position, width, radius).

onboardingForm.$description: An avatar forming: fade, scale, settling blur (ease-out).

onboardingMomentAvatar.$description: The moment: the avatar starts forming.

onboardingMomentPaper.$description: The moment: the paper line rises.

onboardingMomentName.$description: The moment: the name starts travelling onto the paper.

onboardingMomentLines.$description: The moment: the two lines arrive.

onboardingReturnPaper.$description: Back onto the moment: the paper line returns.

onboardingReturnLines.$description: Back onto the moment: the two lines return.

onboardingPersonName.$description: The intention step: the person's name rises in under their avatar.

onboardingHandoffPerson.$description: The hand-off: the person's avatar starts travelling into their row.

onboardingHandoffHome.$description: The hand-off: Home's card, rows and pill fade in.

onboardingHandoffPray.$description: The hand-off: the blue button starts becoming the pray button (last).

onboardingHandoffGlyph.$description: The hand-off: the praying hands appear in it.

onboardingHandoffWait.$description: The hand-off waits at most this long for Home to show the new rows.

onboardingGlowBreath.$description: Half of the Candlelight glow's breath (a 6.4 s cycle).

onboardingReduceMotionBeat.$description: Reduce Motion: no onboarding beat waits longer than this.

outBack.$description: The check's spring (Flutter's Curves.easeOutBack). The only overshoot in the app.
